children: Systematix Corporate Services has reported a consolidated net profit of ₹13.13 crore for September quarter FY27 compared with a loss of ₹4.89 crore in the preceding three months, as total expenses declined while income remained largely stable.
The company's total income was ₹58.80 crore in July-September quarter, compared with ₹58.92 crore in April-June period, according to a regulatory filing on the stock exchanges.
Total expenses declined to ₹41.61 crore from ₹62.01 crore in the previous quarter.
On a year-on-year basis, the financial services firm's total income rose to ₹58.80 crore from ₹56.51 crore, it added.

During the September quarter, the group's investment banking business closed 10 transactions worth around ₹2,350 crore across IPOs, open offers, buybacks and mergers and acquisitions. Total capital raised, including block deals, stood at ₹3,744 crore.

The company said its investment banking pipeline comprised over 27 active opportunities worth ₹12,600 crore, while draft offer documents for transactions exceeding ₹3,000 crore were filed during the quarter.
The group's assets under management (AUM) rose to ₹1,151 crore, while assets under custody (AUC) increased to ₹12,200 crore.

"Our Investment Banking franchise delivered robust transaction execution, while asset management achieved significant milestones across its AIF and PMS platforms," said Nikhil Khandelwal, Chairman & Managing Director at Systematix Corporate Services Ltd.
Khandelwal said: "We continue to invest in strengthening our private wealth business through leadership, technology, talent and geographical expansion."
Founded in 1985, Systematix Group operates across investment banking, institutional equities, merchant banking, NBFC, asset management and wealth management.

title: Systematix Corporate Services Q2 profit at ₹13 cr
